title: 第13章 一剑秒杀前往血灵渊第14章 斩灵海境血傀紫电蝎毒
content_zh:
第13章一剑秒杀，前往血灵渊！
“跟他废话什么，直接杀了，抢夺令牌就是。”
周扬语气平淡，眼神冰冷，根本就没把林尘放在眼中。
林尘身旁的柳嫣然，倒是让周扬很感兴趣。
他眼中闪过一抹邪恶之色。
“周兄，此人虽然没有武魂，但据说剑道实力了得，不可大意。”
陈轩正色道。
“剑修？都什么年代了，还有人练剑！
笑死人了！”
周扬神色轻蔑，剑道传承断绝的大环境下，所谓剑修，不过笑话。
陈轩阴沉着脸，带着身边众多真传弟子杀出。
柳嫣然召唤出五星冰凤武魂，片片冰花飘荡，寒气袭来，冰冷刺骨。
柳嫣然正要动手，却见一道剑光闪过，剑气如狂风，横扫全场。
鲜血飞溅，陈轩身边的真传弟子，瞬间被剑气斩灭，头颅抛飞，身首异处。
陈轩脸色剧变，召唤金羽鹰武魂，正要发力，却见一道剑芒在他瞳孔之中迅速放大。
陈轩心中大骇，催动护体铠甲，转攻为守，金羽鹰武魂化出一对金色双翼将其护住。
下一刻。
金色双翼崩溃，护体光罩破灭，地阶极品的护体铠甲，无法抵挡林尘一剑！
陈轩整个人被剑气拦腰斩断，横死当场！
周扬脸色狂变，没想到林尘的实力如此恐怖。

陈轩并不弱，成为灵剑宗圣子之后，宗主苏墨直接为他灌顶，将其境界提升到了灵纹五重，而且给了他一件珍贵的护体铠甲。
陈轩的金羽鹰武魂，同样达到了五星层次，只是不如林尘以前的弑天虎武魂那般强大。
如此实力，被一剑秒杀，周扬看不懂。
但很快，周扬反应过来，唤出紫电貂武魂，身形暴掠而来，打出一片紫色闪电！
周扬好歹是大禹学院内院天才，战斗经验丰富，很快调整好了心境，在他看来，林尘剑道再强，终究没有武魂作为支撑，根基不足。
此刻，周扬火力全开，没有任何大意轻敌，他的紫电貂武魂属于五星极品层次，比陈轩要强得多。
紫色闪电从天而降，周扬轰出狂暴一拳，拳风呼呼作响，伴随着一道道紫色闪电，威力惊人。
柳嫣然体内灵力爆发，凝聚出一道冰凌杀出，挡住紫色闪电轰击。
与此同时，一道剑光亮起。
林尘手持凌风剑，施展御风剑诀，快到不可思议！
一剑出，狂风呼啸，剑气纵横。
周扬的一条手臂，直接飞了出去，鲜血横流！
content_en:
Chapter 13: Kill instantly with one sword and head to the Blood Spirit Abyss!
"What nonsense are you talking to him about? Just kill him and grab the token."
Zhou Yang's tone was calm and his eyes were cold. He didn't take Lin Chen into consideration at all.
Liu Yanran beside Lin Chen made Zhou Yang very interested.
An evil look flashed in his eyes.
"Brother Zhou, although this person does not have a martial spirit, it is said that he has great swordsmanship, so he should not be careless."
Chen Xuan said seriously.
"Sword cultivator? What age are we in, and there are still people practicing swordsmanship!
It’s so funny! "
Zhou Yang looked contemptuous. In an environment where the inheritance of swordsmanship was cut off, the so-called swordsmanship was just a joke.
Chen Xuan had a gloomy face and led many true disciples around him to fight out.
Liu Yanran summoned the five-star ice phoenix martial spirit, and pieces of ice flowers floated, and the cold air hit her, biting the bones.
Just as Liu Yanran was about to take action, she saw a flash of sword light, and the sword energy swept across the entire place like a strong wind.
Blood spattered, and the true disciples beside Chen Xuan were instantly killed by the sword energy. Their heads were thrown away and their bodies were missing.
Chen Xuan's expression changed drastically, and he summoned the Golden Feather Eagle Martial Spirit. Just as he was about to exert force, he saw a sword light rapidly enlarging in his pupils.
Chen Xuan was horrified, activated his protective armor, and switched from offense to defense. The Golden Feather Eagle Martial Spirit formed a pair of golden wings to protect him.
The next moment.
The golden wings collapsed, the protective shield was shattered, and the top-grade protective armor was unable to withstand Lin Chen's sword!
Chen Xuan was cut in half by the sword energy and died on the spot!
Zhou Yang's expression changed wildly, he didn't expect Lin Chen's strength to be so terrifying.
Chen Xuan is not weak. After becoming the Holy Son of the Spirit Sword Sect, the sect leader Su Mo directly initiated him, raising his realm to the fifth level of spiritual patterns, and gave him a precious body armor.
Chen Xuan's Golden Feather Eagle martial spirit has also reached the five-star level, but it is not as powerful as Lin Chen's previous Sky-Slaying Tiger martial spirit.
With such strength, Zhou Yang couldn't understand that he was killed instantly with a sword.
But soon, Zhou Yang reacted, summoned the purple electric mink martial spirit, and rushed over, shooting out a purple lightning!
After all, Zhou Yang was a genius in the inner courtyard of Dayu Academy. He had rich combat experience and quickly adjusted his state of mind. In his opinion, no matter how strong Lin Chen's swordsmanship was, he had no martial soul to support him and his foundation was insufficient.
At this moment, Zhou Yang was firing on all cylinders and was not underestimating the enemy. His purple electric mink martial spirit belonged to the five-star level and was much stronger than Chen Xuan.
Purple lightning fell from the sky, and Zhou Yang punched violently. The wind of the fist roared, accompanied by streaks of purple lightning, which was astonishingly powerful.
The spiritual power in Liu Yanran's body exploded, and she condensed a stream of ice and shot out, blocking the purple lightning bombardment.
At the same time, a sword light lit up.
Lin Chen held the Lingfeng Sword and used the Wind Control Sword Technique, which was incredibly fast!
As soon as the sword came out, the wind roared and the sword energy was everywhere.
One of Zhou Yang's arms flew out directly, with blood flowing everywhere!
